{{Color|Event}} |contains = 5 |music-1 = [[File:Tower Defense Simulator OST - Frost Crate Opening|thumb|center|250px]] }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|A chilling wind creeps into the room.|Inventory Description}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Frost Crate''' is an exclusive crate that was obtainable during the [[Frost Invasion Event]] from the [[Frost Invasion Event#Frost Invasion Season Pass|Frost Invasion Season]] at Rank 2, 5, 8 and 10. Ranks 2 and 5 would give you one '''Frost Crate''', while Ranks 8 and 10 would give you two. This crate provides special frost-themed skins that cannot be earned from any other crate. The appearance of the '''Frost Crate''' is a grey and blue chest. It has a light blue keyhole with white wings. It is opened with a metallic grey key. ==Skins== {| class="light-table align-center pad-5" style="width:300px; margin:0 auto" ! |[[File:DHFrostPyroIcon.png|175px]] |[[File:Frostminigunnerrework.png|175px]] |[[File:Frostrangernew.png|175px]] |[[File:May17FrostCommander.png|175px]] |- !Skin |{{Color|Frost|Frost}} |{{Color|Frost|Frost}} |{{Color|Frost|Frost}} |{{Color|Frost|Frost}} |- !Rarity |{{Color|Event}} |{{Color|Event}} |{{Color|Event}} |{{Color|Event}} |- !Tower |[[Pyromancer]] |[[Minigunner]] |[[Ranger]] |[[Commander]] |- ! |[[File:FrostMortarIconIG.png|175px]] |- !Skin |{{Color|Frost|Frost}} |- !Rarity |{{Color|Legendary}} |- !Tower |[[Mortar]] |} ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Crate Icons}} FrostCrate.png|First version (28 May 2021 – 22 April 2026) {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} FrostCrateKey.png|Key used to open the '''Frost Crate'''. }} ==Trivia== *The {{Color|Frost|Frost}} [[Mortar]] skin was teased to be a part of this crate, with it also being included in the trailer for the [[Frost Invasion Event]]. However, this skin was not added in the actual event. **It was then released three years after the [[Frost Invasion Event]] ended in the [[v1.46.0|Operation I.C.E Update]]. *Oddly, you could get six '''Frost Crates''', but you can only unlock five skins. **At various points after the [[Frost Invasion Event]]'s release, you could only get up to four crates or up to five crates. ==Update History== *'''8 May 2021''' - [[Overhaul v1.3|Overhaul v1.3.0]] **'''Frost Crate''' added. *'''4 December 2021''' - [[v1.0.0]] **'''Frost Crate''' is no longer obtainable. *'''21 December 2022''' - [[v1.6.0]] **Skin rarity added. **{{Bug}} Crate opening music no longer plays. *'''28 October 2023''' - [[v1.9.0]] **{{Bugfix}} Crate opening music now plays. *'''16 December 2024''' - [[v1.46.0]] **1 skin added. ***[[Mortar]]: {{Color|Frost|Frost}} *'''22 April 2026''' - [[v1.89.0]] **Icon changed. *'''21 August 2026''' - [[v2.7.0]] **Category changed from {{Color|Event}} to {{Color|Common|Default}}. {{CrateNavBox}}
